interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for pedestrian or bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower driving speeds and reduce the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.
